subject: POC prompt set + eval dataset - next steps and timelines
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: POC scope + prompts/logs we discussed

Hi Jordan - thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call (please correct me if I missed anything):

- Goal: Evaluate Redwood inference for Acme Health clinical notes summarization and triage routing to reduce triage time by 30% and false-negative triage misses by 20%.
- Success criteria (high level): average summarization latency < 300ms per request (p95), extractive accuracy >= 88% on the provided gold set, and routing precision >= 85% on triage labels.
- Timeline: 4-week POC (data onboarding + eval + deployment tests) starting as soon as sample prompts/logs arrive; target kickoff next week if we get the dataset by Fri 10/16.
- Ownership: Marissa (sales) will coordinate kickoff and logistics; Aditya (solutions) will own the evaluation plan and infra; Neha (security) will validate data handling/KMS and signing of the DPA.

Next steps I promised on the call:
1) Send the minimal prompt set + sample logs you mentioned (we need ~500 representative prompts/requests and a ~1k-line sample of anonymized logs). CSV/JSONL preferred.
2) Confirm success criteria and any additional KPIs (we sketched three above).
3) Sign the mutual NDA/DPA (Neha will follow up with the security questionnaire).
4) Agree on the POC kickoff date once we have the assets.

Can you share the prompt CSV and one sample log file to the Drive folder I created? I put a placeholder link in the doc (see below). If you prefer SFTP, we can provide credentials.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4d5E6fAcmePOC

Thanks - we'll prepare a short eval plan once we have the files and will share the timeline and milestones for sign-off.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0123

Attachments: acme_success_criteria.xlsx (stub)

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sujay Kumar <sujay.kumar@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: POC scope + prompts/logs we discussed

Hi Marissa - thanks for the thorough recap. Confirming the high-level items look right from our side. A few clarifications and attachments:

- Success criteria spreadsheet (attached) includes the gold labels for 750 records; we see extractive accuracy target at 90% internally but willing to set 88% for the POC pass.
- We can provide the prompt set as a CSV (acme_prompts_v1.csv) - columns: prompt_id, patient_age_bucket, note_type, prompt_text, expected_label (optional).
- Sample logs: anonymized JSONL with 1,200 lines showing typical request/response pairs (acme_sample_logs_20261011.jsonl). Sensitive fields have been tokenized.
- Timeline: We can upload both files to the Drive folder by EOD Thu 10/15; want to start the kickoff the week of 10/19. That should give your team time to spin up the eval infra.

On security: Neha, please advise on our side if you need any additional paperwork. Our Security team will expect a completed SCC/DP agreement and the SOC2 attestation.

Jordan
Director of Data Science | Acme Health
jordan.lee@acmehealth.com

Attachments: acme_prompts_v1.csv (stub), acme_sample_logs_20261011.jsonl (stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: POC scope + prompts/logs we discussed

Perfect - thanks Jordan, that timing works. Attached below is the eval plan outline we'll execute once we ingest the files. High level plan (Aditya owning execution):

- Week 0 (ingest & baseline): validate CSV/JSONL schema, run a quick sanity-run on a small subset, baseline current internal metric numbers.
- Week 1 (model fit & config): run Redwood defaults and two lightweight quant variants; measure p95 latency and token costs.
- Week 2 (eval & scorecards): run the full 750/1.2k sets, compute extractive accuracy, precision/recall for triage labels, and latency percentiles; create a scorecard and qualitative failure cases.
- Week 3 (integration tests + handoff): run routing tests against the triage simulator, document expected infra/config, and present results to Acme stakeholders.

Deliverables: weekly scorecards, final evaluation report, and recommended model/config for Dedicated or Hosted run.

Action items for Jordan: drop the two files to the Drive folder by Thu 10/15 and share any additional mapping docs for labels.
Action items for us: Aditya will provision a small eval cluster (2x A100-equivalent) and run the baseline within 48 hours of ingestion; Neha will share the DPA and data handling checklist.

If you're happy with the plan we'll send a concise Statement of Work outlining timelines and responsibilities.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: Eval plan outline (summary in body)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 11:43:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Acme Health POC kickoff prep

Quick internal note - Jordan confirmed they will upload the files by EOD today (10/15). Please prioritize the following:

- Aditya: prep the eval infra (2x A100-ish, Docker image tag: redwood/eval:2026-10-01), and draft the eval notebook we'll use to compute extractive accuracy and routing precision. Aim to have baseline run within 48 hours of ingestion.
- Neha: send over the DPA + data handling checklist we discussed and flag any gating items for Acme. We should be ready to accept the tokenized logs into the S3 bucket under the Acme POC workspace with KMS keys scoped to the project.
- Marissa: I'll draft the short SOW and send to Jordan for signature once we confirm the files.

Also, Jordan asked about whether we can support redaction automation - Aditya, can you check whether we can run a quick PII scrub step in the ingestion pipeline and provide an option to re-tokenize?

Thanks - this will be a quick win if we get the data in today.

Marissa
